confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and coffee anchors come from Australian national and other-city aggregate estimates, mostly 2026 or undated, cross-checked against undated Wollongong comparison pages. Beer assumes a 425 ml schooner-size restaurant serving; a 285 ml pot would be lower. No current Wollongong bar or wine data was found, so cocktail (about 2.2x beer) and wine glass (about 1.3x beer) are set by the local beer relationship and cross-checked against NSW, Sydney and Melbourne bar and wine prices; pour sizes vary, so these are medium-low. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge of regional NSW coastal rates; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked, so hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain. FX is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation from search results; the 19 Nov figure was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional NSW coastal city about 80 km south of Sydney; priced against Australian national aggregates and Sydney/Melbourne 2026 guide ranges, with Wollongong comparison pages as a cross-check. Accommodation benchmarked by judgement to comparable regional NSW coastal towns.
